contract: All discovered tests/**/*.test.js and scripts/verify-offline*.mjs run serially. New matching files are current by default. No historical exclusions or expected-failure suppressions exist. A known-debt note is not a waiver.

Reconciled source replayed on exact published-v46-based f94e5a8: all 23 cases PASS, including retained guards and separate current daily/legacy yearly infant cooldown coverage. This is focused evidence, not a current aggregate waiver.

The eight unselected birth cases were NOT RUN for that command; no whole-file/current aggregate waiver. Original birth/snapshot/effect/old-v6 guards and the full twelve-life stress cohort remain required.

tests/stress/childhood-lifetimes.test.js.coreCoverage: tests/birth-v9.test.js retains every other original birth/snapshot/old-v6 compatibility test and adds one complete current childhood using the identical shared per-life assertions. All 22 UI cases and the companion entry-flow case passed the pre-integration serial rerun, including retained pre-maze compatibility modes and the actual age-16 settlement/steward/profession form. Any later failure still blocks; no waiver.

tests/ui-v22.test.js.knownDebt: Sixteen remote workspace menu assumption predates accepted six-main-view navigation. Keyboard/modal integrity and anti-forgery behavior remain required. No waiver: failures block.

browser-layout.description: Real browser, narrow and desktop widths, 100% and 150% reading size, clipping/reflow and current navigation. Not measured by Node/fake DOM/CSS source assertions.

screen-reader.description: Real assistive-technology reading order, names, selected state, focus return and announcement behavior. Semantic source/handler tests are not this verification.

tierPolicy: Full is the default and requires every test. New tests default to core even under tests/stress/. Only individually reviewed stress entries with a reason and retained core coverage can be omitted from an explicit core-only run; omission is NOT RUN, never PASS.
